answer: An agent economy can require each account to lock a scarce stake before accessing valuable tasks. Verified work builds a reputation thread; evidence-backed challenges let independent arbitrators slash the stake and revoke credentials after fraud. A sybil attacker must fund every fake account separately and wait for each to earn trust. Coordinated abuse can trigger a ripple of forfeitures, making influence costly to acquire and risky to use, even before reaching summit-level access.
